name: Xiǎo Yǎng
source:
The female protagonist and the child being raised. Her personality, and the trajectory of her life, is based on how the player raises her.

[spoiler] She is later revealed to be the reincarnation of Linsu, the exorcist who saved their home from Lucifer. [/spoiler]
